description.zh:
指定返回参数**RegionName**和**ZoneName**的语言，取值说明：
- **zh**：默认值，中文。
- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the returned **RegionName** and **ZoneName** parameter values. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English
The instance type of the instance.

description.zh:
实例的数据库类型。取值：
- **normal**：副本集实例。
- **sharding**：分片集群实例。
description.en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

- **normal**: replica set instance

- **sharding**: sharded cluster instance
The database engine version of the instance.

description.zh: 当前地域过滤此输入的可用区查询结果，结合“ExcludeZoneId”实现多可用区过滤。
description.en: The secondary zone ID that is excluded from the query results. You can configure the ExcludeZoneId and ExcludeSecondaryZoneId parameters to specify the IDs of multiple zones that are excluded from the query results.

description.zh: 当前地域过滤此输入的可用区查询结果。
description.en: The zone ID that is excluded from the query results.

description.zh:
付费类型。取值：
- **PrePaid**（默认值）：包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：按量付费。
description.en:
The billing method of the product. Valid values:

- **PrePaid**: subscription

- **PostPaid:** pay-as-you-go

description.zh:
实例类型，取值： 
- **sharding**：分片集群实例。
- **replicate**：副本集实例和单节点实例。
description.en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

- **sharding**: sharded cluster instance

- **replicate**: replica set or standalone instance
The edition of the instance. High-Available Edition and Preview Edition (dbfs) are supported.
The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the latest available regions.

description.zh:
节点数。

> 该参数仅支持副本集实例。
description.en:
The number of nodes in the instance.

> This parameter is available only for replica set instances.

Valid values:

- 1

- 3

- 5

- 7

description.zh: 资源组ID。资源组详情请参见[查看资源组基本信息](~~151181~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

description.zh:
存储类型：

- **cloud**：仅展示支持云盘版实例的可用区。
- **local**：仅展示支持本地盘版实例的可用区。
- **default**或空：展示本地盘和云盘版实例都支持的可用区。
description.en:
The storage type. Valid values:

- **cloud**: displays only zones available for instances that use cloud disks.

- **local**: only displays zones available for instances that use local disks instances.

- **default** or unspecified: displays zones available for instances that use cloud disks and those that use local disks.

description.zh:
存储类型，取值说明： 

- **cloud_essd1**：ESSD PL1云盘。
- **cloud_essd2**：ESSD PL2云盘。
- **cloud_essd3**：ESSD PL3云盘。
-  **local_ssd**：SSD本地盘。

>- 4.4及以上版本实例只支持云盘，不填写默认选择**cloud_essd1**。
>- 4.2及以下版本实例只支持本地盘，不填写默认选择**local_ssd**。
description.en:
The storage type. Valid values:

- **cloud\_essd1**: PL1 Enterprise SSDs (ESSDs)

- **cloud\_essd2**: PL2 ESSDs

- **cloud\_essd3**: PL3 ESSDs

- **local\_ssd**: local SSDs

> * Instances that run MongoDB 4.4 or later only use cloud disks to store data. If you do not specify this parameter, the value **cloud\_essd1** is used by default.
>
> * Instances that run MongoDB 4.2 and earlier only use local disks to store data. If you do not specify this parameter, the value **local\_ssd** is used by default.

description.zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~61933~~)查询。
description.en: The zone ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query available zones.

title.zh: 查看实例支持的可用区

descriptions.zh: 查询给定购买条件下，支持的MongoDB可用区列表。购买条件中，地域ID必填。
descriptions.en: Queries the zones in which an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance can be deployed under specified purchase conditions. The region ID is required in the purchase condition.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-availability-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --instance-charge-type PrePaid --db-type normal --resource-group-id rg-acfmx2m4rqu7pry --accept-language zh --storage-support local --mongo-type dbfs --storage-type local_ssd --exclude-zone-id cn-shanghai-g --exclude-secondary-zone-id cn-shanghai-b --db-instance-class dds.mongo.standard --engine-version 5.0 --replication-factor 3 --instance-type replicate --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeAvailabilityZones --region cn-hangzhou --MongoType dbfs --StorageType local_ssd --EngineVersion '5.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmx2m4rqu7pry' --ReplicationFactor 3 --DBInstanceClass 'dds.mongo.standard' --InstanceChargeType PrePaid --DbType normal --StorageSupport local --AcceptLanguage zh --ExcludeZoneId 'cn-shanghai-g' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType replicate --ExcludeSecondaryZoneId 'cn-shanghai-b'
